about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells dessert-inspired body care.
description: {name} case study: an ecommerce storefront for a body care range with matching social creative, a Meta carousel ad and a Google Shopping ad.
brief: {name} sells dessert-inspired body care. We built an ecommerce storefront for the range, paired with social creative and ads for the same products.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.

showcases.title: Homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A bright homepage with an offer bar, a hero built around the products, a 2 Freebies offer, a strip of product promises and a phone version that carries the same look.

showcases.title: Social creative tiles
showcases.text: Square tiles that use the product jars and the same pink and lilac palette as the site.

showcases.title: A Meta carousel ad and a Google Shopping ad
showcases.text: The carousel steps through products and offers. The Shopping ad lists products with price and sale tags.

flow.reach: Meta carousel ad and Google Shopping ad

alts.hero: {name} website, ads and social creative shown together
alts.web: {name} homepage on a laptop and a phone: a Dessert for Your Skin hero with two women and the body butter range, an offer bar and a Start Your Body Care button
alts.card: {name} logo beside a body butter jar, a body oil bottle and raspberries, with a woman resting her chin on her hand
